document: National identity document (metal or synthetic polythene identity card)
office: the Registrar-General of Births, Deaths and National Registration

routes.label: initial registration at a Registrar-General's office

note: The National Registration (Fees) (Amendment) Regulations 2024 (S.I. 10 of 2024), in US dollars: initial registration is free for persons aged between 16 and 18 and US$2 above 18; replacing a lost or defaced metal or polythene identity document costs US$10 for a resident (US$20 urgently), and exchanging a metal card for a polythene one US$20 (not modelled). The card's term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: Statutory Instrument 10 of 2024, National Registration (Fees) (Amendment) Regulations, 2024 (No. 18), Veritas copy
